div.head: I Atr 1.4
div.ab: Gif hy þonne aþ syllan ne durron, gange to þam þryfealdan ordale.
Gyf hi ðonne að syllan ne durron, gange to ðam ðrifealdan ordale.
Si iurare pro eo non audeant, uadat ad triplex ordalium.
Gyf hi ðonne að syllan ne durron, gange to ðam ðrifealdan ordale.
If they dare not give the oath, he (the accused) shall go to the triple ordeal.
Wenn sie [Herr und Helfer] aber den Eid nicht zu leisten wagen, schreite [Verklagter] zum dreifachen Ordal.
But if they [the lord and helpers] do not dare to give the oath, let [the accused] go to the threefold ordeal.
